verdict.rationale: Elicit's own Routines feature, documented on the Alerts page, can run without the user present, act on what it finds and 'hand you a finished analysis' (elicit-docs-80). Research Reports and Systematic Reviews produce long-form outputs (elicit-docs-69, elicit-docs-79), but nothing shows they run in the background after the user leaves. The only documented notifications are instant email alerts for newly found papers, not alerts that a job has finished (elicit-docs-3). missing for 10: documented background or unattended execution of a long research job, notification (email or otherwise) when a job completes, documentation of how Routines deliver their results, hands-on corroboration.
